teaser.en: The climbing cousin of mkone: same kind of leaves, but it reaches up into the bush instead of standing on its own.
teaser.sw: Binamu wa mkone anayetambaa: majani ya aina moja, lakini hupanda juu ya vichaka badala ya kusimama peke yake.

summary.en: Mkone chibugu is a scrambling Grewia that Digo speakers see as the climbing form of mkone. Pakia's informants told the two apart by their leaves and habit.
summary.sw: Mkone chibugu ni *Grewia* anayetambaa ambaye wasemaji wa Kidigo humwona kuwa umbo la kutambaa la *mkone*. Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliwatofautisha wawili hao kwa majani na mtindo wa ukuaji wao.

about.en:
*Mkone chibugu* is a scrambling or climbing shrub of the genus *Grewia*. Its leaves look like those of *mkone* (*Grewia plagiophylla*), but instead of standing up as a shrub or small tree it leans and climbs through other vegetation. Like other grewias, it has simple, toothed leaves with three main veins from the base, small star-shaped flowers, and small round fruits that split into lobes.

Pakia's informants identified it by its leaves.
about.sw:
*Mkone chibugu* ni kichaka kinachotambaa au kupanda wa jenasi *Grewia*. Majani yake yanafanana na ya *mkone* (*Grewia plagiophylla*), lakini badala ya kusimama wima kama kichaka au mti mdogo, huegemea na kupanda katikati ya mimea mingine. Kama *Grewia* wengine, una majani sahili yenye meno pembeni na mishipa mikuu mitatu kutoka kwenye kitako, maua madogo yenye umbo la nyota, na matunda madogo ya mviringo yanayogawanyika kuwa sehemu kadhaa.

Watoa taarifa wa Pakia waliutambua kwa majani yake.

where.en: It grows in coastal bushland and thicket, where grewias are among the commonest shrubs.
where.sw: Hukua katika nyika ya vichaka ya pwani na vichaka, ambako *Grewia* ni miongoni mwa vichaka vinavyopatikana kwa wingi zaidi.

names.en: The name means 'climbing *mkone*': Pakia explains that the species has a climbing form (*-bugu*, as in *chibugu*, a climber) but resembles *mkone*. Duruma shares the name. There is no English or Swahili name in the sources.
names.sw: Jina hili maana yake ni '*mkone* anayetambaa': Pakia anaeleza kwamba spishi hii ina umbo la kutambaa (*-bugu*, kama katika *chibugu*, mtambaa) lakini inafanana na *mkone*. Kiduruma kinashiriki jina hili. Hakuna jina la Kiingereza au Kiswahili katika vyanzo.

reason.en: The upright mkone it is named after
reason.sw: Mkone uliosimama wima ambao jina lake limetokana nao
